scope: normalized RF data plane; not the PS/RFDC board wrapper

capture.group_data: four groups x HI,HQ,VI,VQ signed16 (HI in low16); group0..2 logical ranges; group3 AUX
capture.sample_seq: external RF sample index, continuous across missing data; one index per125MHz edge
capture.onset_and_eop: external validated producer; includes actual onset GSC and immutable context/noise snapshots
capture.record_axis: 128-bit clk_mem AXIS, retain data/keep/last under backpressure; completion is buffer ownership, not host delivery

replay.group_index: task groups1..4 and banks0..3 map to16 physical bank indices
replay.read_response: index captured with issued read, not selected from following cycle request
replay.identity_policy: epoch,generation,pulse,start sequence/start pointer exact; positive count no larger than frozen bank count
replay.active_identity: uses active task until actual RAW token retirement; next queue head cannot replace active reader generation
replay.return_policy: consumer2, legal group/bank, actual frozen lease and epoch/generation match; bad tokens counted and consumed without ACK
replay.downstream_admission: actual RF permit, pipeline ready, DRFM mode2, no stop/config/mode change; task DAC mask equals frozen configured enabled calibrated lanes
replay.latency_contract: downstream_latency_ticks and latency_validated must describe the configured reference plane and complete downstream path; the integration test uses168 ticks for the DSP reference and does not validate RF/DAC absolute output time

live.selection: external explicitly qualified range0..2; range3 or invalid deasserts source validity
live.limitation: does not independently establish analog range qualification

reset.hard: coordinated assertion across domains; board/control adapter must ensure safe release and DMA isolation
reset.soft: block new captures/replay submits; drain producers/upload/queue/DSP; owner increments epoch and clears remaining unsubmitted leases

external_control_domains.t_prefix: clk_rf except t_awg_ctrl_* use clk_ctrl; feedback already normalized/synchronized by trusted board adapter
external_control_domains.binding: all RF physical codes, gains, polarities, pins and timing stay in external contracts

remaining: PS register/profile/task loading and CSR/event wiring
RFDC native streams and ADC FIR/quality/detector/noise producer integration
real board clocks/reset/physical CDC and pin constraints
